note: Small family-owned RV park on the west side of Geneva, beside the owners' mobile home park, with a small pond behind it (no fish). Back-in sites about 80 ft long with green space between; communal fire pit. No restrooms or showers. Campers may be put on the mobile home side. No asphalt or road-construction crews (spill rule since 2020). --Claude
summary: The operator's site confirms $30 a night (5 + 2 free), 50 A full hookups at every site, year-round operation, no restrooms or showers, and reservations by phone/text (not required); all written. It also says 'we have no pull-throughs', contradicting the derived pull_through: true, now false. Gate facts pass: posted $30, working site with phone, Google 4.2 from 27. The pond is ~0.6 acre, so lakeview goes down to not waterfront. It shares a property with a mobile home park but says it does not do residential camping.
flags: WATERFRONT lakeview -> not waterfront: NAIP shows the pond NE of the office as an elongated basin ~115 m by ~25 m, about 0.3 ha (~0.6 acre), well under the ~5-acre pond line, and AWH's rule allows no pond-view. The operator calls it 'a small pond' with 'no fish'. (The home page's 'beyond the lake' refers to the same pond.)
SITES pull_through true -> false: the operator says 'Sorry, we have no pull-throughs'. Imagery shows angled back-in pads along the park road.

LONG-STAY (five tests): one nightly rate posted, no weekly/monthly rate, nightly stays sold by phone, and the operator states 'We do not, at this time, do residential camping'. But the RV sites share the property with a mobile home park ('You may be required to stay on the mobile home side'), and a 7-year-old Google review describes 'Campsites have spaces in a well maintained mobile home park'. Imagery: the RV row (NE side, ~10 pads) is separate from the mobile homes (SW side). Reads as a nightly RV park beside a mobile home park; human call, lean keep.

GATE FACTS: posted rate $30 (operator about-us page); website https://www.lakeshorerv-geneva.com/ with phone (402) 759-3883 (matches stored); Google 4.2 from 27 reviews; RV Life 4.5/$$ (stored). Good Sam status not checked.

PIN (optional, ~105 m): stored 40.52850,-97.61480 is on the highway shoulder at the park's west edge. The RV pad row centres near 40.5289,-97.6137; Google's point 40.52919,-97.61445 is the office at the north end of the row.
